title: Sun Zara
desc: Trisha is mesmerised by aspiring singer Rohit's voice. After the two fall in love, Trisha meets with an accident and loses her eyesight.

title: Shamitabh
desc: An aspiring actor with the inability to speak, joins forces with a man who has a powerful voice. Together they take the film industry by storm, but will their egos get in the way?

title: Shootout At Lokhandwala
desc: A film based on a real-life gun battle between the Mumbai police and gangsters in Mumbai Lokhandwala Complex in 1991. The movie follows the story of a notorious gangster, and his team who terrorize the city with their crimes. As the police close in on them, a bloody shootout ensues, leaving many dead on both sides. The film explores the complex dynamics between law enforcement and organized crime in Mumbai's underworld.

title: One Two Three
desc: Three men named Laxmi Narayan—a wannabe hitman, a loyal aide to a powerful boss, and a women’s lingerie salesman—travel on business to Pondicherry and unexpectedly check into the same hotel.

title: Munna Baba(dub) (unakaga Ellam Unakka Tamil)
desc: Sakthi, a rich spoilt brat falls for Indhu. His father, Vinu meets his friend Jayaganesh and they agree on a marriage proposal for their children. Sakthi wants to break the deal because he loves Indhu and wants to marry her, but he does not realise that Indhu is Jayaganesh's daughter. He tries to break the engagement by asking his cousins to misbehave and indulge in a fight. Ultimately in the end, the two get married.
